00J: Command Sergeant Major (CSM) Engineer/Signal/Military Police/Military Intelligence Immaterial

This code (00J) will be used to identify approved command sergeant major duty positions in organizational authorization documents that are interchangeable between career management fields (CMF) 12 (Engineer), 25 (Signal), 31 (Military Police) and CMF 35 (Military Intelligence) and to report the duty MOS for Soldiers assigned to these positions. Authorization documents will not be identified with SRC 00J prior to approval by HQDA, ODCS G-1 (DAPE- PRP-CSB)(see table 14-2).. Refer to chapter 14 for specifications, applications and restrictions.

00Z: Serves as the senior enlisted person for the command. Serves as the standard bearer in all things in the command including fitness and appearance. Provides guidance and expertise to the command on the Army’s Professional Ethic. Serves as the expert on Army and organizational history, traditions, customs and courtesies. Leads all enlisted talent management within the command. Serves as the principal enlisted advisor to the Commanding General. Provides advice and makes recommendations to senior leaders and staff on all matters pertaining to enlisted soldiers and their families. Manages enlisted professional development across the command.). Serves as the lead agent in the development of subordinate personnel. Disseminates information, command/organization policies, objectives and guidance to subordinate NCO Support Chain to ensure successful completion of missions. Develops and recommends courses of action for policy development and critical senior leader decisions. Provides guidance to create efficiencies and streamline processes. Develops methods to improve readiness. Performs other duties prescribed by their senior leader.
